reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Phase 03's code reading is factually incorrect. The claim states 'data columns are added to cache during KZG verification (block_verification.rs:1324-1332)' but verify_kzg_for_rpc_block (L353-406 in data_availability_checker.rs) does NOT cache columns—it only verifies KZG proofs and returns MaybeAvailableBlock::Available with columns embedded inline. Columns are only cached via explicit put_kzg_verified_data_columns calls (L266, L323, L619), which occur AFTER blocks are processed. The RPC handler (rpc_methods.rs:425-428) calls get_data_columns_checking_all_caches which queries data_availability_checker and early_attester_cache, but blocks failing state transition do not have columns added to these caches because caching happens post-import, not during verification. The 01e requirement (outputs/01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json, L624-639) states 'forall sidecar in resp: state_transition_valid(sidecar.block) == true', but this is enforced implicitly by the import flow: only successfully imported blocks have cached columns. Verified by reading beacon_chain.rs:1125-1144, data_availability_checker.rs:202-207, 353-406, block_verification.rs:1320-1335.
